"""pressure_vessel — traceable pressure vessel / storage tank design calculations.

Engineering-review tool, not a certified code calculator. Every result carries
its inputs, formula, code reference (with verification state), material data
source and an explicit status. Nothing produced by this package is approved for
fabrication; that decision belongs to a qualified engineer.
"""

__version__ = "0.1.0"

DISCLAIMER = (
    "Generated by pressure_vessel {v}. Engineering-review tool only: results are "
    "PRELIMINARY until material data and code references are verified against the "
    "licensed edition and a qualified engineer has reviewed and approved them. "
    "Not approved for fabrication."
).format(v=__version__)

"""API 650 storage tank calculations (separate code family).

Implemented: scope gate against project-stated limits, shell course
thickness by the 1-foot method (design and hydrostatic test cases), minimum
nominal thickness from the user-confirmed table, Sd/St cross-check against
the stated derivation rule, bottom minimum thickness, weights and capacity.
Everything else (variable-design-point method, roof, wind girders,
anchorage, Annex E seismic, settlement, nozzles) is listed as NOT_EVALUATED
or OUT_OF_SCOPE.

SI form of the 1-foot method: D in m, H in m, S in MPa, t in mm:
    td = 4.9 D (H - 0.3) G / Sd + CA        tt = 4.9 D (H - 0.3) / St
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math

from ... import __version__
from ...inputs.tank_schema import TankInput
from ...references import ReferenceRegister
from ...status import RecordKind, Status
from ...trace import CalcRecord

MM, MPA = "mm", "MPa"


def _unver(refs, ids, extra=()):
    return list(refs.unverified(ids)) + list(extra)


def one_foot_td(D_m, H_m, G, Sd, CA):
    return 4.9 * D_m * (H_m - 0.3) * G / Sd + CA


def one_foot_tt(D_m, H_m, St):
    return 4.9 * D_m * (H_m - 0.3) / St


def run(ti: TankInput, refs: ReferenceRegister, validation=None) -> dict:
    recs: list[CalcRecord] = []
    rules_unv = [] if ti.rules_status in ("VERIFIED_OFFICIAL", "USER_SUPPLIED_VERIFIED") else \
        [f"API 650 constants (min thickness table, bottom minimum) {ti.rules_status}"]

    sc = CalcRecord("API-SCOPE", "Tank", "API 650 applicability", code_family="API_650",
                    method="design conditions vs project-stated limits of the API 650 part used",
                    references=["API650:1.1"], criterion="internal/external pressure and temperature within the stated limits")
    lim = ti.scope_limits
    sc.inp("P_internal", ti.internal_pressure, MPA)
    sc.inp("P_external", ti.external_pressure, MPA)
    sc.inp("T_max", ti.max_temp, "degC")
    for k, v in lim.items():
        sc.inp(k, v, "", lim.get("basis", ""))
    if None in (lim["max_internal_pressure"], lim["max_external_pressure"], lim["max_temperature"]):
        sc.questions.append("state the scope limits of the API 650 part used, from the licensed edition")
        recs.append(sc.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="scope limits not stated"))
        in_scope = None
    else:
        in_scope = (ti.internal_pressure <= lim["max_internal_pressure"] and
                    ti.external_pressure <= lim["max_external_pressure"] and ti.max_temp <= lim["max_temperature"])
        if not in_scope:
            recs.append(sc.finalize(out_of_scope="design conditions outside the stated API 650 limits: select another "
                                                 "code (e.g. API 620, ASME VIII) — no API 650 result is produced"))
        else:
            sc.criterion_met = True
            recs.append(sc.finalize(unverified=_unver(refs, sc.references, ["scope limits stated by the user"])))
    if in_scope is False:
        return _assemble(ti, refs, recs, validation)

    D_m = ti.D / 1000.0
    tmin_tab = next((t for dmax, t in ti.rules["min_shell_thickness"] if ti.D <= dmax), None)
    one_ft_max = ti.rules["one_foot_max_diameter"]
    z = 0.0
    selected = {}
    for cc in ti.courses:          # bottom to top
        m = ti.materials[cc.material]
        rec = CalcRecord(f"API-SH-{cc.id}", f"Shell course {cc.id}", f"Shell course {cc.id}, 1-foot method",
                         code_family="API_650", method="5.6.3 1-foot method, design and hydrostatic test",
                         references=["API650:5.6.3", "API650:5.6.1.1", "API650:5.6.2.1"],
                         criterion="t_nom >= max(td, tt, t_min)")
        H_m = rec.inp("H", (ti.H - z) / 1000.0, "m", "design liquid level above the bottom of this course")
        rec.inp("D", D_m, "m")
        rec.inp("G", ti.G, "-")
        rec.inp("CA", ti.ca_shell, MM)
        Sd = rec.inp("Sd", m.Sd, MPA, m.source, source=f"MATERIAL {m.status}")
        St = rec.inp("St", m.St, MPA, m.source, source=f"MATERIAL {m.status}")
        z += cc.height
        if one_ft_max is None:
            rec.questions.append("1-foot method diameter limit not stated")
            recs.append(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="method limit not stated"))
            continue
        if ti.D > one_ft_max:
            recs.append(rec.finalize(out_of_scope="diameter above the 1-foot method limit: variable-design-point "
                                                  "method not implemented"))
            continue
        if Sd is None or St is None or tmin_tab is None:
            rec.questions.append("Sd, St and the minimum thickness table are needed")
            recs.append(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="Sd/St/minimum thickness missing"))
            continue
        if H_m <= 0.3:
            td = tt = 0.0
        else:
            td = rec.mid("td", one_foot_td(D_m, H_m, ti.G, Sd, ti.ca_shell), MM)
            tt = rec.mid("tt", one_foot_tt(D_m, H_m, St) if ti.G_test == 1.0 else one_foot_tt(D_m, H_m, St) * ti.G_test, MM)
            rec.eq("td = 4.9 D (H - 0.3) G / Sd + CA", f"4.9 x {D_m:.3f} x ({H_m:.3f} - 0.3) x {ti.G:g} / {Sd:.1f} + {ti.ca_shell:g} = {td:.3f} mm")
            rec.eq("tt = 4.9 D (H - 0.3) / St", f"4.9 x {D_m:.3f} x ({H_m:.3f} - 0.3) / {St:.1f} = {tt:.3f} mm")
        rec.mid("t_min_table", tmin_tab, MM, "5.6.1.1 (user-confirmed table)")
        need = rec.mid("t_required", max(td, tt, tmin_tab), MM)
        extra = list(rules_unv)
        if m.Fy and m.Fu:
            sd_rule = min(2 / 3 * m.Fy, 2 / 5 * m.Fu)
            st_rule = min(3 / 4 * m.Fy, 3 / 7 * m.Fu)
            rec.mid("Sd_rule", sd_rule, MPA, "min(2/3 Fy, 2/5 Fu) cross-check")
            rec.mid("St_rule", st_rule, MPA, "min(3/4 Fy, 3/7 Fu) cross-check")
            if Sd > sd_rule + 0.5 or St > st_rule + 0.5:
                rec.warnings.append("stated Sd/St exceed the derivation rule: verify against Table 5-2")
                extra.append("Sd/St inconsistent with the derivation rule")
        if cc.nominal_thickness is None:
            t_nom = next((t for t in ti.plate_thicknesses if t >= need - 1e-9), None)
            if t_nom is None:
                rec.criterion_met = False
                recs.append(rec.finalize())
                continue
        else:
            t_nom = cc.nominal_thickness
        rec.res("t_nom", t_nom, MM)
        rec.res("margin", t_nom - need, MM)
        rec.criterion_met = t_nom >= need - 1e-9
        selected[cc.id] = t_nom
        if m.status not in ("VERIFIED_OFFICIAL", "USER_SUPPLIED_VERIFIED"):
            extra.append(f"material {m.key} {m.status}")
        recs.append(rec.finalize(unverified=_unver(refs, rec.references, extra)))

    b = CalcRecord("API-BOTTOM", "Bottom", "Bottom plate minimum thickness", code_family="API_650",
                   method="5.4.1 minimum + corrosion allowance", references=["API650:5.4.1"],
                   criterion="t_bottom >= t_min + CA")
    tbm = ti.rules["bottom_min_thickness"]
    if ti.bottom_thickness is None or tbm is None:
        recs.append(b.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="bottom thickness or rule value missing"))
    else:
        b.inp("t_bottom", ti.bottom_thickness, MM)
        b.mid("t_min", tbm + ti.ca_bottom, MM)
        b.criterion_met = ti.bottom_thickness >= tbm + ti.ca_bottom - 1e-9
        bm = ti.materials.get(ti.bottom_material)
        recs.append(b.finalize(unverified=_unver(refs, b.references, rules_unv +
                                                 ([f"material {bm.key} {bm.status}"] if bm and bm.status not in
                                                  ("VERIFIED_OFFICIAL", "USER_SUPPLIED_VERIFIED") else []))))

    w = CalcRecord("API-WT", "Tank", "Shell and bottom weights, capacity", code_family="API_650",
                   kind=RecordKind.COMPUTATION, method="plate volumes x density", references=["GEN:mechanics"])
    Ws = 0.0
    for cc in ti.courses:
        if cc.id in selected:
            m = ti.materials[cc.material]
            Ws += math.pi * (ti.D + selected[cc.id]) * selected[cc.id] * cc.height * m.density * 1e-9
    w.res("W_shell", Ws, "kg", "shell courses at mean diameter")
    if ti.bottom_thickness:
        bm = ti.materials.get(ti.bottom_material)
        w.res("W_bottom", math.pi / 4 * ti.D ** 2 * ti.bottom_thickness * (bm.density if bm else 0) * 1e-9, "kg",
              "flat bottom to the shell diameter (projection and lap not included)")
    w.res("V_design", math.pi / 4 * ti.D ** 2 * ti.H / 1e9, "m3", "to the design liquid level")
    w.res("W_test_water", math.pi / 4 * ti.D ** 2 * ti.H * 1000 * ti.G_test * 1e-9, "kg")
    recs.append(w.finalize())

    for cid, title in (("API-ROOF", f"Roof ({ti.roof})"), ("API-WIND-GIRDER", "Top angle / wind girders (5.9)"),
                       ("API-WIND", "Wind overturning and sliding (5.11)"), ("API-SEISMIC", "Seismic design (Annex E)"),
                       ("API-ANCHOR", "Anchorage (5.12)"), ("API-NOZZLES", "Shell openings and reinforcement (5.7)"),
                       ("API-ANNULAR", "Annular bottom plates (5.5)"), ("API-SETTLEMENT", "Foundation / settlement")):
        r = CalcRecord(cid, "Tank", title, code_family="API_650", method="not implemented in v0.1",
                       references=["API650:1.1"])
        recs.append(r.finalize(out_of_scope="not implemented in v0.1"))
    return _assemble(ti, refs, recs, validation, selected)


def _assemble(ti, refs, recs, validation, selected=None):
    used = sorted({r for rec in recs for r in rec.references})
    counts = {s.value: 0 for s in Status} | {"COMPUTED": 0}
    for r in recs:
        counts["COMPUTED" if r.kind == RecordKind.COMPUTATION else r.status.value] += 1
    rd = [r.to_dict() for r in recs]
    blockers = []
    if any(r.status == Status.FAIL for r in recs):
        blockers.append("FAIL present")
    if any(r.mandatory and r.kind == RecordKind.CHECK and r.status != Status.PASS for r in recs):
        blockers.append("mandatory checks not PASS")
    if refs.summary(used)["unverified_ids"]:
        blockers.append("code references not verified")
    blockers.append("verification suite not run for this result set")
    questions = [f"{q.field}: {q.message}" for q in validation.questions] if validation else []
    questions += [f"{r.calc_id}: {q}" for r in recs for q in r.questions]
    return {"results": {
        "schema": "pv-design/results@1", "software": {"name": "pressure_vessel", "version": __version__},
        "project": ti.project, "input_hash": ti.input_hash, "input_file": ti.source_path,
        "code": {"design_code": "API_650", "edition": ti.project.get("code_edition")},
        "records": rd, "summary": {"counts": counts}, "selected_thickness_mm": selected or {},
        "reference_register": refs.summary(used), "questions": questions,
        "results_hash": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rd, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest(),
        "gate": {"stage": "PRELIMINARY", "blockers": blockers,
                 "fabrication_release": "NOT RELEASED — engineering review and approval required"}},
        "records": recs, "geometry": None}

"""Material, joint-efficiency, shell-course and head calculation records."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ...geometry.profiles import HeadProfile
from ...status import RecordKind
from ...trace import CalcRecord
from . import formulas as F
from .context import TABLE_UW12, Ctx

MM, MPA, C = "mm", "MPa", "degC"


def material_records(ctx: Ctx):
    p = ctx.vi.process
    for key, ma in ctx.vi.materials.items():
        if ma.record is None:
            rec = CalcRecord(f"MAT-{key}", f"Material {key}", f"Non-pressure material {ma.spec}",
                             kind=RecordKind.COMPUTATION, code_family="PROJECT", method="data record",
                             references=["PROJECT:requirement"])
            rec.res("density", ma.density, "kg/m3", source=f"INPUT ({ma.status})")
            if ma.min_yield:
                rec.res("Fy", ma.min_yield, MPA, "minimum yield (user input)", source=f"INPUT ({ma.status})")
            ctx.add(rec.finalize())
            continue
        r = ma.record
        rec = CalcRecord(f"MAT-{key}", f"Material {key}", f"Allowable stress, {r.name}",
                         method="material database lookup (exact or linear between tabulated temperatures)",
                         references=["ASME2D:Table1A"], materials=[key],
                         criterion="design and test temperatures within the record's tabulated range")
        rec.inp("record", r.id, source=f"MATERIAL_DB {ctx.matdb.version}")
        rec.inp("status", str(r.status))
        rec.inp("source", r.source_document)
        rec.inp("T_design", p.design_temperature, C)
        rec.inp("T_test", p.test_temperature, C)
        ok = True
        for sym, T in (("S_design", p.design_temperature), ("S_test", p.test_temperature)):
            S, how = ctx.S(key, T)
            if S is None:
                ok = False
                rec.warnings.append(how)
                rec.res(sym, None, MPA, how)
            else:
                rec.res(sym, S, MPA, how, source=f"MATERIAL:{r.id}")
        if p.external_design_temperature is not None:
            S, how = ctx.S(key, p.external_design_temperature)
            rec.res("S_ext_T", S, MPA, how, source=f"MATERIAL:{r.id}")
        rec.criterion_met = ok
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references, [key])))


def _E_table(j) -> tuple[float | None, str]:
    row = TABLE_UW12.get(j.joint_type, {})
    if j.radiography not in row:
        return None, f"Table UW-12 has no entry for type {j.joint_type} with {j.radiography} radiography"
    return row[j.radiography], f"Table UW-12 type {j.joint_type}, {j.radiography} RT"


def joint_records(ctx: Ctx):
    fab = ctx.vi.fabrication
    for name, j in fab.joints.items():
        rec = CalcRecord(f"JE-{name}", "Weld joints", f"Joint efficiency, {name.replace('_', ' ')}",
                         kind=RecordKind.COMPUTATION, method="Table UW-12 lookup",
                         references=["ASME8-1:UW-3", "ASME8-1:UW-11", "ASME8-1:TableUW-12"])
        rec.inp("category", j.category)
        rec.inp("joint_type", j.joint_type)
        rec.inp("radiography", j.radiography)
        E, how = _E_table(j)
        rec.res("E", E, "-", how, source="CODE_TABLE:ASME8-1:TableUW-12")
        if E is None:
            rec.warnings.append(how)
        ctx.joint_E[name] = E
        ctx.add(rec.finalize())


def seamless_head_E(ctx: Ctx) -> tuple[float, str, list[str]]:
    """UW-12(d) for seamless heads: 1.0 when the UW-11(a)(5)(b) spot RT is met
    and the head-to-shell weld is Type 1 or 2; otherwise 0.85."""
    fab = ctx.vi.fabrication
    j = ctx.joint("head_to_shell")
    notes = []
    met = fab.spot_rt_uw11a5b
    if j is not None and j.radiography == "full":
        met = True if met is None else met
    if met is None:
        notes.append("UW-11(a)(5)(b) compliance not stated: E = 0.85 used (conservative); confirm")
        return 0.85, "UW-12(d): compliance not stated -> 0.85", notes
    if met and j is not None and j.joint_type in (1, 2):
        return 1.0, "UW-12(d): seamless head, UW-11(a)(5)(b) spot RT met -> 1.0", notes
    return 0.85, "UW-12(d): seamless head, spot RT not met or Type 3-6 joint -> 0.85", notes


def _select_plate(ctx: Ctx, t_design: float, und) -> tuple[float | None, float, str]:
    for t in ctx.vi.fabrication.plate_thicknesses:
        ded, _ = F.plate_undertolerance_deduction(t, und)
        if t - ded >= t_design - 1e-9:
            return t, ded, f"smallest listed plate with t - undertolerance >= {t_design:.3f} mm"
    return None, 0.0, "no listed plate thickness is sufficient"


def shell_records(ctx: Ctx):
    vi, p, g = ctx.vi, ctx.vi.process, ctx.vi.geometry
    CA = p.corrosion_allowance
    D = g.inside_diameter
    E_long = ctx.joint_E.get("shell_longitudinal")
    E_circ = ctx.joint_E.get("shell_circumferential")
    und = vi.fabrication.plate_undertolerance
    z = g.bottom_tangent_elevation + g.heads["bottom"].straight_flange
    for cc in g.shell_courses:
        z_bottom = z
        z += cc.length
        rec = CalcRecord(f"SH-{cc.id}", f"Shell course {cc.id}",
                         f"Cylindrical shell {cc.id} under internal pressure",
                         method="UG-27(c)(1) circumferential and UG-27(c)(2) longitudinal stress; "
                                "UG-16(b) minimum; UG-16(c) plate undertolerance; UG-25 corrosion",
                         references=["ASME8-1:UG-27(c)(1)", "ASME8-1:UG-27(c)(2)", "ASME8-1:UG-16(b)",
                                     "ASME8-1:UG-16(c)", "ASME8-1:UG-25"],
                         materials=[cc.material],
                         criterion="t_avail = t_nom - u - CA >= max(t_req, 1.5 mm)")
        Pc = rec.inp("P", ctx.P_at(z_bottom), MPA, "design pressure + static head at course bottom")
        rec.inp("D", D, MM, "inside diameter (new)")
        rec.inp("CA", CA, MM)
        S, how = ctx.S(cc.material, p.design_temperature)
        rec.inp("S", S, MPA, how, source=f"MAT-{cc.material}")
        rec.inp("E_long", E_long, "-", "Category A joint (circumferential stress)", source="JE-shell_longitudinal")
        rec.inp("E_circ", E_circ, "-", "Category B joint (longitudinal stress)", source="JE-shell_circumferential")
        rec.inp("u", und, MM, "plate mill undertolerance")
        if S is None or E_long is None or E_circ is None:
            rec.questions.append("allowable stress and both joint efficiencies are needed")
            ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="missing S or E"))
            continue
        R = rec.mid("R", D / 2 + CA, MM, "corroded inside radius D/2 + CA")
        try:
            tc = rec.mid("t_circ", F.shell_t_circ(Pc, R, S, E_long), MM)
            rec.eq("t_circ = P R / (S E_long - 0.6 P)",
                   f"{Pc:.4f} x {R:.2f} / ({S:.1f} x {E_long:.2f} - 0.6 x {Pc:.4f}) = {tc:.3f} mm")
            tl = rec.mid("t_long", F.shell_t_long(Pc, R, S, E_circ), MM)
            rec.eq("t_long = P R / (2 S E_circ + 0.4 P)",
                   f"{Pc:.4f} x {R:.2f} / (2 x {S:.1f} x {E_circ:.2f} + 0.4 x {Pc:.4f}) = {tl:.3f} mm")
        except F.OutOfScope as exc:
            ctx.add(rec.finalize(out_of_scope=str(exc)))
            continue
        t_req = rec.mid("t_req", max(tc, tl), MM, "governing: " + ("circumferential" if tc >= tl else "longitudinal"))
        t_min = rec.mid("t_min", max(t_req, F.UG16B_MIN), MM, "max(t_req, UG-16(b) 1.5 mm)")
        t_des = rec.mid("t_design", t_min + CA, MM, "t_min + CA")
        if cc.nominal_thickness is None:
            t_nom, ded, why = _select_plate(ctx, t_des, und)
            rec.mid("selection", why)
            if t_nom is None:
                rec.criterion_met = False
                ctx.add(rec.finalize())
                continue
        else:
            t_nom = cc.nominal_thickness
            ded, _ = F.plate_undertolerance_deduction(t_nom, und)
        _, why_u = F.plate_undertolerance_deduction(t_nom, und)
        rec.res("t_nom", t_nom, MM, "selected nominal plate" if cc.nominal_thickness is None else "specified nominal plate")
        rec.mid("u_deducted", ded, MM, why_u)
        t_av = rec.res("t_avail", t_nom - ded - CA, MM, "corroded available thickness")
        rec.eq("t_avail = t_nom - u_deducted - CA", f"{t_nom:g} - {ded:g} - {CA:g} = {t_av:.3f} mm")
        rec.res("margin", t_av - t_min, MM)
        rec.criterion_met = t_av >= t_min - 1e-9
        extra = ["plate undertolerance not stated"] if und is None else []
        ctx.selected[cc.id] = t_nom
        ctx.available[cc.id] = t_av
        ctx.required[cc.id] = F.shell_t_circ(Pc, R, S, 1.0)
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references, [cc.material], extra)))

        m = CalcRecord(f"SH-{cc.id}-MAWP", f"Shell course {cc.id}", f"MAWP of shell course {cc.id}",
                       kind=RecordKind.COMPUTATION, method="UG-27 solved for P; static head deducted (UG-98)",
                       references=["ASME8-1:UG-27(c)(1)", "ASME8-1:UG-27(c)(2)", "ASME8-1:UG-98"],
                       materials=[cc.material])
        m.inp("t", t_av, MM, "corroded available thickness", source=f"SH-{cc.id}")
        m.inp("R", R, MM)
        try:
            pc = m.mid("P_circ", F.shell_mawp_circ(t_av, R, S, E_long), MPA)
            pl = m.mid("P_long", F.shell_mawp_long(t_av, R, S, E_circ), MPA)
            m.eq("P_circ = S E_long t / (R + 0.6 t)", f"{S:.1f} x {E_long:.2f} x {t_av:.3f} / ({R:.2f} + 0.6 x {t_av:.3f}) = {pc:.4f} MPa")
            m.eq("P_long = 2 S E_circ t / (R - 0.4 t)", f"2 x {S:.1f} x {E_circ:.2f} x {t_av:.3f} / ({R:.2f} - 0.4 x {t_av:.3f}) = {pl:.4f} MPa")
            sh = m.mid("static_head", ctx.static_head(z_bottom), MPA)
            mw = m.res("MAWP_top", min(pc, pl) - sh, MPA, "MAWP referred to the top of the vessel")
            ctx.mawp_parts[f"shell {cc.id}"] = mw
        except F.OutOfScope as exc:
            m.warnings.append(str(exc))
            ctx.mawp_notes.append(f"shell {cc.id}: MAWP not computed ({exc})")
        ctx.add(m.finalize())


def _head_formula(h, P, D, R, S, E, CA, t=None):
    """Return (t_req or MAWP, formula text, substitution, refs, extra mids)."""
    if h.type == "ellipsoidal":
        ar = h.aspect_ratio
        K = F.ellipsoidal_K(ar)
        refs = ["ASME8-1:App1-4(c)"] + (["ASME8-1:UG-32-ellipsoidal"] if abs(ar - 2.0) < 1e-9 else [])
        if t is None:
            v = F.ellipsoidal_t(P, D, S, E, ar)
            return v, "t = P D K / (2 S E - 0.2 P), K = (2 + (D/2h)^2)/6", \
                f"{P:.4f} x {D:.2f} x {K:.4f} / (2 x {S:.1f} x {E:.2f} - 0.2 x {P:.4f}) = {v:.3f} mm", refs, {"K": K}
        v = F.ellipsoidal_mawp(t, D, S, E, ar)
        return v, "P = 2 S E t / (K D + 0.2 t)", \
            f"2 x {S:.1f} x {E:.2f} x {t:.3f} / ({K:.4f} x {D:.2f} + 0.2 x {t:.3f}) = {v:.4f} MPa", refs, {"K": K}
    if h.type == "torispherical":
        L, r = h.crown_radius + CA, h.knuckle_radius + CA
        M = F.torispherical_M(L, r)
        refs = ["ASME8-1:App1-4(d)", "ASME8-1:UG-32-geometry"]
        if t is None:
            v = F.torispherical_t(P, L, r, S, E)
            return v, "t = P L M / (2 S E - 0.2 P), M = (3 + sqrt(L/r))/4", \
                f"{P:.4f} x {L:.2f} x {M:.4f} / (2 x {S:.1f} x {E:.2f} - 0.2 x {P:.4f}) = {v:.3f} mm", refs, {"L": L, "r": r, "M": M}
        v = F.torispherical_mawp(t, L, r, S, E)
        return v, "P = 2 S E t / (L M + 0.2 t)", \
            f"2 x {S:.1f} x {E:.2f} x {t:.3f} / ({L:.2f} x {M:.4f} + 0.2 x {t:.3f}) = {v:.4f} MPa", refs, {"L": L, "r": r, "M": M}
    L = R
    refs = ["ASME8-1:UG-32-hemispherical"]
    if t is None:
        v = F.hemispherical_t(P, L, S, E)
        return v, "t = P L / (2 S E - 0.2 P)", \
            f"{P:.4f} x {L:.2f} / (2 x {S:.1f} x {E:.2f} - 0.2 x {P:.4f}) = {v:.3f} mm", refs, {"L": L}
    v = F.hemispherical_mawp(t, L, S, E)
    return v, "P = 2 S E t / (L + 0.2 t)", f"2 x {S:.1f} x {E:.2f} x {t:.3f} / ({L:.2f} + 0.2 x {t:.3f}) = {v:.4f} MPa", refs, {"L": L}


def head_records(ctx: Ctx):
    vi, p, g = ctx.vi, ctx.vi.process, ctx.vi.geometry
    CA, D = p.corrosion_allowance, g.inside_diameter
    E_seam, E_why, E_notes = seamless_head_E(ctx)
    for pos in ("bottom", "top"):
        h = g.heads[pos]
        tag = f"HD-{pos.upper()[:3]}"
        depth = HeadProfile(h.type, D / 2, h.aspect_ratio or 2.0, h.crown_radius or 0.0,
                            h.knuckle_radius or 0.0).depth
        z_ref = g.bottom_tangent_elevation - depth if pos == "bottom" \
            else g.bottom_tangent_elevation + g.tangent_to_tangent
        rec = CalcRecord(tag, f"{pos.capitalize()} head", f"{h.type.capitalize()} head ({pos}) under internal pressure",
                         method="UG-32 / Appendix 1-4 with corroded dimensions; UG-16(b) minimum",
                         references=["ASME8-1:UG-16(b)", "ASME8-1:UG-25"], materials=[h.material],
                         criterion="t_min_formed - CA >= max(t_req, 1.5 mm)")
        P = rec.inp("P", ctx.P_at(z_ref), MPA, "design pressure + static head at the head's lowest point")
        rec.inp("D", D, MM)
        rec.inp("CA", CA, MM)
        S, how = ctx.S(h.material, p.design_temperature)
        rec.inp("S", S, MPA, how, source=f"MAT-{h.material}")
        if h.construction == "seamless":
            E = rec.inp("E", E_seam, "-", E_why, source="ASME8-1:UW-12(d)")
            rec.references.append("ASME8-1:UW-12(d)")
            rec.warnings.extend(E_notes)
        else:
            E = rec.inp("E", h.joint_efficiency_override, "-", "welded head: user-stated E of the welds within the head")
            rec.references.append("ASME8-1:TableUW-12")
        if S is None or E is None:
            ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="missing S or E"))
            continue
        Dc = rec.mid("D_c", D + 2 * CA, MM, "corroded inside diameter")
        Rc = Dc / 2
        try:
            t_req, f_txt, sub, refs, extra = _head_formula(h, P, Dc, Rc, S, E, CA)
        except F.OutOfScope as exc:
            ctx.add(rec.finalize(out_of_scope=str(exc)))
            continue
        rec.references.extend(refs)
        for k, v in extra.items():
            rec.mid(k, v, MM if k in ("L", "r") else "-")
        rec.eq(f_txt, sub)
        t_req = rec.mid("t_req", t_req, MM)
        t_min = rec.mid("t_min", max(t_req, F.UG16B_MIN), MM, "max(t_req, 1.5 mm)")
        unv_extra = []
        if h.nominal_thickness is None:          # automatic: needs the forming allowance
            need = t_min + CA + (h.forming_allowance or 0.0)
            t_nom = next((t for t in vi.fabrication.plate_thicknesses if t >= need - 1e-9), None)
            rec.mid("t_plate_needed", need, MM, "t_min + CA + forming allowance")
            if t_nom is None:
                rec.criterion_met = False
                ctx.add(rec.finalize())
                continue
            t_formed = t_nom - (h.forming_allowance or 0.0)
            unv_extra.append("minimum thickness after forming derived from the stated forming allowance")
        else:
            t_nom = h.nominal_thickness
            if h.min_thickness_after_forming is not None:
                t_formed = h.min_thickness_after_forming
            else:
                t_formed = t_nom - h.forming_allowance
                unv_extra.append("minimum thickness after forming derived from the stated forming allowance")
        rec.res("t_nom", t_nom, MM, "nominal plate")
        rec.res("t_min_formed", t_formed, MM, "minimum thickness after forming")
        Lc = F.head_crown_radius(h.type, Dc, h.aspect_ratio or 2.0, (h.crown_radius or 0) + CA)
        if Lc:
            rec.mid("ts/L", t_formed / Lc, "-", "applicability ts/L >= 0.002 (Appendix 1-4(f) otherwise)")
            rec.references.append("ASME8-1:App1-4(f)")
            try:
                F.thin_head_scope(t_formed, Lc)
            except F.OutOfScope as exc:
                ctx.add(rec.finalize(out_of_scope=str(exc)))
                continue
        t_av = rec.res("t_avail", t_formed - CA, MM, "corroded available thickness")
        rec.res("margin", t_av - t_min, MM)
        if h.type == "torispherical":
            Do_skirt = D + 2 * t_nom
            issues = F.torispherical_geometry_issues(h.crown_radius, h.knuckle_radius, Do_skirt, t_formed)
            rec.mid("geometry_issues", "; ".join(issues) or "none")
            if issues:
                rec.criterion_met = False
                rec.status_reasons.append("head geometry limits not met: " + "; ".join(issues))
                ctx.add(rec.finalize())
                continue
        rec.criterion_met = t_av >= t_min - 1e-9
        ctx.selected[pos] = t_nom
        ctx.available[tag] = t_av
        # required thickness at E = 1 for UG-45 tb1 / UG-37 tr of head nozzles
        ctx.required[tag] = _head_formula(h, P, Dc, Rc, S, 1.0, CA)[0]
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references, [h.material], unv_extra + (
            [] if h.construction == "welded" else [n for n in E_notes]))))

        m = CalcRecord(f"{tag}-MAWP", f"{pos.capitalize()} head", f"MAWP of {pos} head",
                       kind=RecordKind.COMPUTATION, method="head formula solved for P; static head deducted",
                       references=list(dict.fromkeys(rec.references + ["ASME8-1:UG-98"])), materials=[h.material])
        m.inp("t", t_av, MM, source=tag)
        try:
            mw, f_txt, sub, _, _ = _head_formula(h, P, Dc, Rc, S, E, CA, t=t_av)
            m.eq(f_txt, sub)
            sh = m.mid("static_head", ctx.static_head(z_ref), MPA)
            v = m.res("MAWP_top", mw - sh, MPA, "referred to the top of the vessel")
            ctx.mawp_parts[f"{pos} head"] = v
        except F.OutOfScope as exc:
            m.warnings.append(str(exc))
        ctx.add(m.finalize())

        # straight flange checked as a cylinder (UG-27) with the head thickness
        if h.straight_flange > 0:
            sf = CalcRecord(f"{tag}-SF", f"{pos.capitalize()} head", f"Straight flange of {pos} head as a cylinder",
                            method="UG-27(c)(1)/(c)(2) with the head's minimum formed thickness",
                            references=["ASME8-1:UG-27(c)(1)", "ASME8-1:UG-27(c)(2)", "ASME8-1:UW-12(d)"],
                            materials=[h.material], criterion="t_avail >= t_req (straight flange)")
            Ec = E_seam if h.construction == "seamless" else h.joint_efficiency_override
            El = ctx.joint_E.get("head_to_shell")
            sf.inp("E_circ_stress", Ec, "-", "seamless section, UW-12(d)")
            sf.inp("E_long_stress", El, "-", "Category B head-to-shell joint")
            try:
                t1 = F.shell_t_circ(P, Rc, S, Ec)
                t2 = F.shell_t_long(P, Rc, S, El) if El else 0.0
                tr = sf.mid("t_req", max(t1, t2), MM)
                sf.eq("t = max(P R/(S E - 0.6P), P R/(2 S E + 0.4P))", f"max({t1:.3f}, {t2:.3f}) = {tr:.3f} mm")
                sf.res("t_avail", t_av, MM)
                sf.criterion_met = t_av >= tr - 1e-9
                ctx.add(sf.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(sf.references, [h.material], E_notes)))
            except F.OutOfScope as exc:
                ctx.add(sf.finalize(out_of_scope=str(exc)))

"""ASME VIII-1 vessel calculation orchestrator and release gate."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import asdict

from ... import __version__
from ...geometry.vessel import build_geometry
from ...inputs.models import VesselInput
from ...materials import MaterialDatabase
from ...references import ReferenceRegister
from ...status import DesignStage, RecordKind, Status, aggregate
from . import components, external, nozzles, vessel_checks
from .context import Ctx


def run(vi: VesselInput, refs: ReferenceRegister, matdb: MaterialDatabase, validation=None) -> dict:
    if vi.reference_verification:
        problems = refs.apply_verification(vi.reference_verification)
        if problems:
            raise ValueError("code_reference_verification: " + "; ".join(problems))
    ctx = Ctx(vi, refs, matdb)
    components.material_records(ctx)
    components.joint_records(ctx)
    components.shell_records(ctx)
    components.head_records(ctx)
    missing = [k for k in [c.id for c in vi.geometry.shell_courses] + ["top", "bottom"] if k not in ctx.selected]
    geometry = None
    if not missing:
        ctx.geometry = geometry = build_geometry(vi, ctx.selected)
        nozzles.nozzle_records(ctx)
        external.external_records(ctx)
    mawp = vessel_checks.mawp_record(ctx)
    weights = None
    test_p = None
    if geometry:
        test_p = vessel_checks.test_records(ctx, mawp)
        weights = vessel_checks.weight_records(ctx)
        vessel_checks.support_records(ctx, weights)
        vessel_checks.lug_records(ctx, weights)
    vessel_checks.load_status_records(ctx)
    apply_assessments(ctx)
    for r in ctx.records:
        for rid in r.references:
            refs.get(rid)          # every cited id must exist in the register
    results = assemble(vi, refs, matdb, ctx, mawp, test_p, weights, validation)
    if geometry:
        geometry["results_hash"] = results["results_hash"]
    return {"results": results, "geometry": geometry, "records": ctx.records}


def apply_assessments(ctx: Ctx):
    """Replace NOT_EVALUATED / OUT_OF_SCOPE status of a check by a recorded
    external engineering assessment. The record keeps the original method
    text and states that the result comes from outside the software."""
    from ...inputs.schema import ASSESSMENT_OK
    from ...status import DataStatus
    by_id = {r.calc_id: r for r in ctx.records}
    for cid, a in ctx.vi.assessments.items():
        r = by_id.get(cid)
        if r is None:
            raise ValueError(f"assessment for unknown calc id {cid!r}")
        if r.kind != RecordKind.CHECK or r.status not in (Status.NOT_EVALUATED, Status.OUT_OF_SCOPE):
            raise ValueError(f"assessment for {cid}: only NOT_EVALUATED/OUT_OF_SCOPE checks can take one "
                             f"(current status {r.status_text})")
        r.method = f"EXTERNAL ASSESSMENT ({a['basis']}) — software scope: {r.method}"
        r.inp("assessment", a["result"], source=f"USER {a['status']} by {a['by']} {a.get('date', '')}".strip())
        r.status_reasons = [f"evaluated outside the software: {a['basis']}"]
        r.questions = []
        r.criterion_met = a["result"].strip().lower() in ASSESSMENT_OK
        unv = [] if DataStatus(a["status"]).release_eligible else [f"assessment {a['status']}"]
        r.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(r.references, r.materials, unv))


def _counts(records):
    out = {s.value: 0 for s in Status}
    out["COMPUTED"] = 0
    for r in records:
        out["COMPUTED" if r.kind == RecordKind.COMPUTATION else r.status.value] += 1
    return out


def release_gate(vi: VesselInput, records, refs: ReferenceRegister, verification: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    checks = [r for r in records if r.kind == RecordKind.CHECK]
    blockers = []
    fails = [r.calc_id for r in checks if r.status == Status.FAIL]
    if fails:
        blockers.append(f"FAIL: {', '.join(fails)}")
    open_ = [f"{r.calc_id} ({r.status})" for r in checks
             if r.mandatory and r.status in (Status.NOT_EVALUATED, Status.OUT_OF_SCOPE, Status.NEEDS_ENGINEERING_REVIEW)]
    if open_:
        blockers.append(f"mandatory checks not PASS: {len(open_)}")
    used = sorted({rid for r in records for rid in r.references})
    unref = refs.summary(used)["unverified_ids"]
    if unref:
        blockers.append(f"code references not verified against the licensed edition: {len(unref)} of {len(used)}")
    unmat = sorted({f"{k} ({m.data_status})" for k, m in vi.materials.items()
                    if m.data_status not in ("VERIFIED_OFFICIAL", "USER_SUPPLIED_VERIFIED")})
    if unmat:
        blockers.append("material data not release eligible: " + ", ".join(unmat))
    if vi.project.data_status != "USER_CONFIRMED":
        blockers.append(f"input data status is {vi.project.data_status}")
    if not vi.design_basis.locked:
        blockers.append("design basis not locked (inputs not confirmed by the user)")
    if verification is None:
        blockers.append("verification suite not run for this result set")
    elif not verification.get("passed"):
        blockers.append("verification suite reported discrepancies")
    stage = DesignStage.PRELIMINARY if blockers else DesignStage.CALCULATION_VERIFIED
    return {"stage": str(stage), "blockers": blockers, "open_mandatory": open_, "fails": fails,
            "fabrication_release": "NOT RELEASED — requires CALCULATION_VERIFIED plus signed engineering "
                                   "review and approval by a qualified engineer (never set by software)"}


def assemble(vi, refs, matdb, ctx: Ctx, mawp, test_p, weights, validation) -> dict:
    recs = [r.to_dict() for r in ctx.records]
    used = sorted({rid for r in ctx.records for rid in r.references})
    by_comp = {}
    for r in ctx.records:
        if r.kind == RecordKind.CHECK:
            by_comp.setdefault(r.component, []).append(r.status)
    questions = []
    if validation is not None:
        questions += [f"{q.field}: {q.message}" for q in validation.questions]
    for r in ctx.records:
        questions += [f"{r.calc_id}: {q}" for q in r.questions]
    body = {
        "schema": "pv-design/results@1",
        "software": {"name": "pressure_vessel", "version": __version__},
        "project": asdict(vi.project), "design_basis": asdict(vi.design_basis),
        "input_file": vi.source_path, "input_hash": vi.input_hash,
        "code": {"design_code": vi.project.design_code, "edition": vi.project.code_edition,
                 "addenda": vi.project.addenda},
        "material_db": {"version": matdb.version, "path": matdb.path,
                        "used": {k: (m.record.to_dict() if m.record else
                                     {"id": k, "name": m.spec, "status": m.status, "density_kg_m3": m.density,
                                      "source_document": "project input (non-pressure)"})
                                 for k, m in vi.materials.items()}},
        "reference_register": refs.summary(used),
        "references_used": [asdict(refs.get(r)) for r in used],
        "records": recs,
        "summary": {"counts": _counts(ctx.records),
                    "by_component": {k: str(aggregate(v)) for k, v in by_comp.items()}},
        "selected_thickness_mm": ctx.selected, "available_thickness_mm": ctx.available,
        "joint_efficiencies": ctx.joint_E,
        "mawp_MPa": mawp, "mawp_parts_MPa": ctx.mawp_parts, "test_pressure_top_MPa": test_p,
        "weights_kg": None if weights is None else {k: v for k, v in weights.items() if k != "cg_empty"},
        "cg_empty_mm": None if weights is None else list(weights["cg_empty"]),
        "questions": questions,
        "validation": None if validation is None else validation.to_dict(),
    }
    body["results_hash"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(recs, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()
    body["gate"] = release_gate(vi, ctx.records, refs, None)
    return body

"""External pressure: UG-28 (cylinders) and UG-33 (formed heads).

Factor A for cylinders (Fig. G) and factor B for every component (material
chart) must be supplied by the user from the licensed Section II-D, with the
source. Nothing is read from an approximation of those charts. Without the
data the checks are NOT_EVALUATED and the report prints the ratios the user
needs to enter the charts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from ...trace import CalcRecord
from .context import Ctx
from .formulas import OutOfScope

MM, MPA = "mm", "MPa"
K0_2TO1 = 0.90  # Table UG-33.1, D/2h = 2.0


def external_records(ctx: Ctx):
    p, g = ctx.vi.process, ctx.vi.geometry
    Pe = p.external_pressure
    data = ctx.vi.external_pressure_data
    if not Pe:
        rec = CalcRecord("EXT-NONE", "External pressure", "External pressure / vacuum",
                         method="design basis states no external pressure", references=["ASME8-1:UG-22"],
                         mandatory=False)
        rec.status_reasons.append("not required: no external pressure in the design basis (confirm no vacuum case)")
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="not required by the design basis"))
        return
    _shell(ctx, Pe, data.get("shell"))
    for pos in ("top", "bottom"):
        _head(ctx, pos, Pe, data.get("heads"))


def _shell(ctx: Ctx, Pe, chart):
    g, CA = ctx.vi.geometry, ctx.vi.process.corrosion_allowance
    rec = CalcRecord("EXT-SHELL", "Shell", "Cylindrical shell under external pressure",
                     method="UG-28(c)(1): Pa = 4B/(3 Do/t), or 2AE/(3 Do/t) left of the material line",
                     references=["ASME8-1:UG-28(c)(1)", "ASME8-1:UG-28(b)", "ASME2D:FigG", "ASME2D:MaterialCharts"],
                     materials=[g.shell_courses[0].material], criterion="Pa >= P_ext")
    rec.inp("P_ext", Pe, MPA)
    # governing course: the thinnest corroded course (same material assumed per course list)
    cid = min((c.id for c in g.shell_courses if c.id in ctx.available), key=lambda k: ctx.available[k], default=None)
    if cid is None:
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="shell thickness not established"))
        return
    t = rec.inp("t", ctx.available[cid], MM, f"corroded available thickness of {cid} (thinnest)", source=f"SH-{cid}")
    Do = rec.inp("Do", g.inside_diameter + 2 * ctx.selected[cid], MM, "outside diameter")
    hb = ctx.geometry["heads"]["bottom"]["inside_depth"]
    ht = ctx.geometry["heads"]["top"]["inside_depth"]
    L = rec.mid("L", g.tangent_to_tangent + (hb + ht) / 3, MM, "T/T + one third of each head depth, no stiffeners (UG-28(b))")
    LDo = rec.mid("L/Do", L / Do, "-")
    Dot = rec.mid("Do/t", Do / t, "-")
    if L / Do > 50:
        rec.mid("L/Do_used", 50.0, "-", "Fig. G entered at 50 for larger values")
    if Do / t < 10:
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(out_of_scope="Do/t < 10: UG-28(c)(2) not implemented"))
        return
    if not chart or ("B" not in chart and not (chart.get("left_of_material_line") and "A" in chart and "E" in chart)):
        rec.questions.append(f"read factor A from II-D Fig. G at L/Do = {min(LDo, 50):.3f} and Do/t = {Dot:.1f}, then "
                             f"factor B from the chart for the shell material at "
                             f"{ctx.vi.process.external_design_temperature:g} degC (or E if A is left of the line)")
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="chart factors A/B not supplied (never approximated)"))
        return
    rec.inp("A", chart.get("A"), "-", chart["source"], source=f"USER ({chart['status']})")
    if chart.get("left_of_material_line"):
        E = rec.inp("E", chart["E"], MPA, chart["source"], source=f"USER ({chart['status']})")
        Pa = rec.res("Pa", 2 * chart["A"] * E / (3 * Dot), MPA)
        rec.eq("Pa = 2 A E / (3 (Do/t))", f"2 x {chart['A']:.3e} x {E:.0f} / (3 x {Dot:.2f}) = {Pa:.4f} MPa")
    else:
        B = rec.inp("B", chart["B"], MPA, chart["source"], source=f"USER ({chart['status']})")
        Pa = rec.res("Pa", 4 * B / (3 * Dot), MPA)
        rec.eq("Pa = 4 B / (3 (Do/t))", f"4 x {B:.2f} / (3 x {Dot:.2f}) = {Pa:.4f} MPa")
    rec.res("margin", Pa - Pe, MPA)
    rec.criterion_met = Pa >= Pe - 1e-12
    extra = [] if chart["status"] in ("VERIFIED_OFFICIAL", "USER_SUPPLIED_VERIFIED") else [f"chart readings {chart['status']}"]
    ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references, rec.materials, extra)))


def _head(ctx: Ctx, pos, Pe, chart):
    g, CA = ctx.vi.geometry, ctx.vi.process.corrosion_allowance
    h = g.heads[pos]
    tag = f"HD-{pos.upper()[:3]}"
    if tag not in ctx.available:
        return
    t = ctx.available[tag]
    D = g.inside_diameter
    # part (a)(1): UG-32 thickness at 1.67 x external pressure, E = 1
    r1 = CalcRecord(f"EXT-{tag}-A1", f"{pos.capitalize()} head", f"{pos.capitalize()} head, external pressure UG-33(a)(1)",
                    method="UG-32 / App. 1-4 thickness with P = 1.67 P_ext and E = 1",
                    references=["ASME8-1:UG-33(a)(1)", "ASME8-1:App1-4(c)", "ASME8-1:App1-4(d)",
                                "ASME8-1:UG-32-hemispherical"], materials=[h.material],
                    criterion="t_avail >= t_req(1.67 P_ext)")
    from .components import _head_formula       # local import avoids a cycle
    S, how = ctx.S(h.material, ctx.vi.process.external_design_temperature)
    r1.inp("P_ext", Pe, MPA)
    r1.inp("S", S, MPA, how)
    if S is None:
        ctx.add(r1.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="allowable stress unavailable"))
    else:
        P = r1.mid("P_equiv", 1.67 * Pe, MPA, "1.67 x P_ext")
        Dc = D + 2 * CA
        try:
            treq, ftxt, sub, _, _ = _head_formula(h, P, Dc, Dc / 2, S, 1.0, CA)
            r1.eq(ftxt, sub)
            r1.mid("t_req", treq, MM)
            r1.res("t_avail", t, MM, source=tag)
            r1.criterion_met = t >= treq - 1e-9
            ctx.add(r1.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(r1.references, r1.materials)))
        except OutOfScope as exc:
            ctx.add(r1.finalize(out_of_scope=str(exc)))
    # part (a)(2): buckling with factor B
    r2 = CalcRecord(f"EXT-{tag}-A2", f"{pos.capitalize()} head", f"{pos.capitalize()} head, external pressure buckling",
                    method="UG-33: A = 0.125/(Ro/t); Pa = B/(Ro/t) or 0.0625 E/(Ro/t)^2",
                    references=["ASME8-1:UG-33(d)", "ASME2D:MaterialCharts"], materials=[h.material],
                    criterion="Pa >= P_ext")
    t_nom = ctx.selected[pos]
    Do = D + 2 * t_nom
    if h.type == "ellipsoidal":
        if abs(h.aspect_ratio - 2.0) > 1e-9:
            ctx.add(r2.finalize(out_of_scope="K0 (Table UG-33.1) only held for 2:1 heads in v0.1"))
            return
        r2.references.append("ASME8-1:TableUG-33.1")
        Ro = r2.mid("Ro", K0_2TO1 * Do, MM, "K0 Do, K0 = 0.90 (Table UG-33.1, 2:1)")
    elif h.type == "torispherical":
        Ro = r2.mid("Ro", h.crown_radius + t_nom, MM, "outside crown radius")
    else:
        Ro = r2.mid("Ro", Do / 2, MM, "outside radius")
    Rot = r2.mid("Ro/t", Ro / t, "-")
    A = r2.mid("A", 0.125 / Rot, "-", "A = 0.125/(Ro/t)")
    r2.eq("A = 0.125 / (Ro/t)", f"0.125 / {Rot:.2f} = {A:.4e}")
    if not chart or ("B" not in chart and not (chart.get("left_of_material_line") and "E" in chart)):
        r2.questions.append(f"read factor B for A = {A:.4e} from the {h.material} material chart at "
                            f"{ctx.vi.process.external_design_temperature:g} degC (or E if left of the line)")
        ctx.add(r2.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="chart factor B not supplied (never approximated)"))
        return
    if chart.get("left_of_material_line"):
        E = r2.inp("E", chart["E"], MPA, chart["source"], source=f"USER ({chart['status']})")
        Pa = r2.res("Pa", 0.0625 * E / Rot ** 2, MPA)
        r2.eq("Pa = 0.0625 E / (Ro/t)^2", f"= {Pa:.4f} MPa")
    else:
        B = r2.inp("B", chart["B"], MPA, chart["source"], source=f"USER ({chart['status']})")
        Pa = r2.res("Pa", B / Rot, MPA)
        r2.eq("Pa = B / (Ro/t)", f"{B:.2f} / {Rot:.2f} = {Pa:.4f} MPa")
    r2.criterion_met = Pa >= Pe - 1e-12
    extra = [] if chart["status"] in ("VERIFIED_OFFICIAL", "USER_SUPPLIED_VERIFIED") else [f"chart readings {chart['status']}"]
    ctx.add(r2.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(r2.references, r2.materials, extra)))

"""Nozzle checks: UG-45 neck thickness, UG-36(b)(1) scope, UG-37 area
replacement with UG-40 limits, flange rating (UG-44), UG-41 status, UG-42
spacing, UW-14 openings near seams.

Area method scope: radial nozzle, F = 1 (longitudinal plane governs), in a
cylindrical shell or on the centreline of a formed head. Everything else is
OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than approximated.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math

from ... import pipes
from ...status import RecordKind
from ...trace import CalcRecord
from . import formulas as F
from .context import Ctx

MM, MPA, MM2 = "mm", "MPa", "mm2"
K1_2TO1 = 0.90   # Table UG-37 K1 for D/2h = 2.0 (register ASME8-1:TableUG-37)


def _parent(ctx: Ctx, ge: dict):
    """(parent tag, material key, kind, head object or None)."""
    g = ctx.vi.geometry
    if ge["location"] == "shell":
        cc = next(c for c in g.shell_courses if c.id == ge["parent"])
        return cc.id, cc.material, "shell", None
    pos = "top" if ge["location"] == "top_head" else "bottom"
    h = g.heads[pos]
    return f"HD-{pos.upper()[:3]}", h.material, "head", h


def _neck_E(ctx: Ctx, nz) -> tuple[float | None, str]:
    neck = nz.neck
    if neck.type == "plate":
        return neck.seam_E, "rolled-plate neck: stated long-seam joint efficiency"
    rec = ctx.vi.materials[neck.material].record
    if rec and "seamless" in rec.product_form.lower():
        return 1.0, "seamless pipe (material record product form)"
    return None, "pipe product form is not stated as seamless: give the neck joint efficiency"


def _neck_avail(ctx: Ctx, nz) -> tuple[float | None, str]:
    fab = ctx.vi.fabrication
    neck, CA = nz.neck, ctx.vi.process.corrosion_allowance
    if neck.type == "pipe":
        if fab.pipe_undertolerance is None:
            return None, "pipe undertolerance not stated (UG-16(d))"
        return neck.wall * (1 - fab.pipe_undertolerance) - CA, \
            f"t_n x (1 - {fab.pipe_undertolerance:.3f}) - CA (UG-16(d))"
    ded, why = F.plate_undertolerance_deduction(neck.wall, fab.plate_undertolerance)
    return neck.wall - ded - CA, f"t_n - u - CA; {why}"


def nozzle_records(ctx: Ctx):
    vi = ctx.vi
    p = vi.process
    CA, D = p.corrosion_allowance, vi.geometry.inside_diameter
    T = p.design_temperature
    geo = {n["tag"]: n for n in ctx.geometry["nozzles"]}
    for nz in vi.geometry.nozzles:
        ge = geo[nz.tag]
        ptag, pmat, pkind, head = _parent(ctx, ge)
        Pn = ctx.P_at(ge["z"]) if pkind == "shell" else ctx.P_at(
            vi.geometry.bottom_tangent_elevation if nz.location == "bottom_head" else ge["z"])
        Sn, how_n = ctx.S(nz.neck.material, T)
        Sv, how_v = ctx.S(pmat, T)
        t_par = ctx.available.get(ptag)
        tr_par = ctx.required.get(ptag)
        _ug45(ctx, nz, ge, Pn, Sn, how_n, tr_par, ptag, pmat)
        _ug37(ctx, nz, ge, Pn, Sn, Sv, how_n, how_v, t_par, ptag, pmat, pkind, head, CA, D)
        _flange(ctx, nz, Pn)
        w = CalcRecord(f"NZ-{nz.tag}-UG41", f"Nozzle {nz.tag}", f"Nozzle {nz.tag} attachment weld strength",
                       method="UG-41 weld load paths", references=["ASME8-1:UG-41"],
                       criterion="weld strength >= load carried (UG-41)")
        w.questions.append("define the attachment weld detail (Fig. UW-16.1 sketch, weld sizes) so the UG-41 "
                           "load paths, or the UG-41(b)(1) exemption, can be evaluated")
        ctx.add(w.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="weld details not defined"))
    _spacing(ctx)


def _ug45(ctx, nz, ge, Pn, Sn, how_n, tr_par, ptag, pmat):
    CA = ctx.vi.process.corrosion_allowance
    rec = CalcRecord(f"NZ-{nz.tag}-UG45", f"Nozzle {nz.tag}", f"Nozzle {nz.tag} neck minimum thickness",
                     method="UG-45: t_UG45 = max(ta, min(tb3, tb1)); access openings ta only",
                     references=["ASME8-1:UG-45", "ASME8-1:TableUG-45", "ASME8-1:UG-27(c)(1)",
                                 "ASME8-1:UG-16(b)", "ASME8-1:UG-16(d)", "ASME:B36.10M"],
                     materials=[nz.neck.material, pmat], criterion="t_neck_avail >= t_UG45")
    rec.inp("P", Pn, MPA)
    rec.inp("OD", nz.neck.od, MM)
    rec.inp("t_n", nz.neck.wall, MM, f"nominal wall ({nz.neck.data_source[:60]})", source=f"PIPE_DATA {nz.neck.data_status}")
    rec.inp("Sn", Sn, MPA, how_n, source=f"MAT-{nz.neck.material}")
    rec.inp("CA", CA, MM)
    En, why_E = _neck_E(ctx, nz)
    rec.inp("E_neck", En, "-", why_E)
    if Sn is None or En is None or tr_par is None:
        rec.questions.append("need the neck allowable stress, the neck joint efficiency and the parent "
                             "required thickness")
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="missing input for UG-45"))
        return
    Rn = rec.mid("Rn", (nz.neck.od - 2 * nz.neck.wall) / 2 + CA, MM, "corroded inside radius of neck")
    try:
        trn = rec.mid("t_rn", F.shell_t_circ(Pn, Rn, Sn, En), MM, "UG-27(c)(1) for the neck")
    except F.OutOfScope as exc:
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(out_of_scope=str(exc)))
        return
    ta = rec.mid("ta", trn + CA, MM, "t_rn + CA")
    rec.eq("ta = P Rn / (Sn E - 0.6 P) + CA", f"{Pn:.4f} x {Rn:.2f} / ({Sn:.1f} x {En:.2f} - 0.6 x {Pn:.4f}) + {CA:g} = {ta:.3f} mm")
    extra = []
    if nz.access_opening:
        t45 = rec.res("t_UG45", ta, MM, "access/inspection opening: ta only")
    else:
        tb1 = rec.mid("tb1", max(tr_par + CA, F.UG16B_MIN + CA), MM,
                      f"parent ({ptag}) required t at E = 1 plus CA, not less than 1.5 mm + CA")
        nps = nz.neck.nps
        if nps is None:
            rec.questions.append("give equivalent_nps of the plate neck for Table UG-45 (tb3)")
            ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="tb3 needs the nominal pipe size"))
            return
        tt, why = pipes.ug45_table_value(nps)
        tb3 = rec.mid("tb3", tt + CA, MM, f"Table UG-45 value + CA; {why}", source="CODE_TABLE (derived)")
        tb = rec.mid("tb", min(tb3, tb1), MM, "min(tb3, tb1) — internal pressure only")
        rec.eq("t_UG45 = max(ta, min(tb3, tb1))", f"max({ta:.3f}, min({tb3:.3f}, {tb1:.3f}))")
        t45 = rec.res("t_UG45", max(ta, tb), MM)
        extra.append("Table UG-45 values derived from the STD wall (unverified derivation)")
    if ctx.vi.process.external_pressure:
        extra.append("external-pressure parts of UG-45 (ta external, tb2) not evaluated")
    tav, why_av = _neck_avail(ctx, nz)
    if tav is None:
        rec.questions.append(why_av)
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason=why_av))
        return
    rec.res("t_neck_avail", tav + CA, MM, why_av.replace(" - CA", ""))
    if tav > 0:
        Pneck = rec.res("MAWP_neck", Sn * En * tav / (Rn + 0.6 * tav), MPA, "UG-27(c)(1) of the corroded neck")
        ctx.mawp_parts[f"neck {nz.tag}"] = Pneck - (Pn - ctx.vi.process.design_pressure)
    rec.res("margin", tav + CA - t45, MM)
    rec.criterion_met = tav + CA >= t45 - 1e-9
    ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references, rec.materials, extra)))


def _seam_E1(ctx, nz, ge, r_open):
    """UW-14 proximity: return (E1, note). E1 = 1 unless the opening passes
    through a seam, in which case the seam's efficiency applies (review)."""
    if ge["location"] != "shell":
        return 1.0, None
    g = ctx.geometry
    z, th = ge["z"], ge["orientation"]
    R = g["vessel"]["inside_diameter"] / 2
    for s in g["seams"]:
        if s["kind"] == "circumferential" and abs(s["z"] - z) < r_open:
            return ctx.joint_E.get("shell_circumferential") or 0.0, f"opening crosses circumferential seam {s['between']}"
        if s["kind"] == "longitudinal" and s["z0"] <= z <= s["z1"]:
            dth = abs((th - s["orientation"] + 180) % 360 - 180)
            if R * math.radians(dth) < r_open:
                return ctx.joint_E.get("shell_longitudinal") or 0.0, f"opening crosses longitudinal seam of {s['course']}"
    return 1.0, None


def _ug37(ctx, nz, ge, Pn, Sn, Sv, how_n, how_v, t, ptag, pmat, pkind, head, CA, D):
    refs = ["ASME8-1:UG-37", "ASME8-1:UG-40", "ASME8-1:UG-36(b)(1)", "ASME8-1:UG-16(d)", "ASME8-1:UW-14"]
    mats = [nz.neck.material, pmat] + ([nz.pad.material] if nz.pad else [])
    rec = CalcRecord(f"NZ-{nz.tag}-UG37", f"Nozzle {nz.tag}", f"Nozzle {nz.tag} reinforcement (area method)",
                     method="UG-37(c) area replacement, Fig. UG-37.1 areas, UG-40 limits; F = 1, radial nozzle",
                     references=refs, materials=mats, criterion="A1 + A2 + A3 + A41 + A42 + A43 + A5 >= A")
    if None in (Sn, Sv, t):
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="missing allowable stress or parent thickness"))
        return
    neck = nz.neck
    d = rec.mid("d", neck.od - 2 * neck.wall + 2 * CA, MM, "finished opening diameter, corroded")
    Rn = d / 2
    # UG-36(b)(1) scope gate
    if pkind == "shell":
        lim = min(D / 2, 508.0) if D <= 1520.0 else min(D / 3, 1000.0)
        rec.mid("d_limit_UG36", lim, MM, "UG-36(b)(1) limit for the area rules in cylindrical shells")
    else:
        lim = D / 2
        rec.mid("d_limit_scope", lim, MM, "implementation scope for central head openings (d <= D/2)")
    if d > lim:
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(out_of_scope=f"d = {d:.1f} mm exceeds {lim:.1f} mm: large-opening rules "
                                          "(Appendix 1-7) not implemented"))
        return
    P = rec.inp("P", Pn, MPA)
    rec.inp("attachment", nz.attachment, "", "set_in = nozzle wall inserted through the shell")
    rec.inp("Sv", Sv, MPA, how_v, source=f"MAT-{pmat}")
    rec.inp("Sn", Sn, MPA, how_n, source=f"MAT-{neck.material}")
    rec.inp("t", t, MM, f"parent {ptag} corroded available thickness", source=ptag)
    tn = rec.inp("tn", neck.wall - CA, MM, "nominal neck wall less CA (no undertolerance, UG-16(d))")
    # tr of the parent, seamless (E = 1)
    if pkind == "shell":
        R = D / 2 + CA
        tr_fn = lambda Pv: Pv * R / (Sv - 0.6 * Pv)          # noqa: E731
        tr = F.shell_t_circ(P, R, Sv, 1.0)
        rec.eq("tr = P R / (Sv - 0.6 P)  (E = 1)", f"{P:.4f} x {R:.2f} / ({Sv:.1f} - 0.6 x {P:.4f}) = {tr:.3f} mm")
    elif head.type == "ellipsoidal":
        if abs(head.aspect_ratio - 2.0) > 1e-9:
            ctx.add(rec.finalize(out_of_scope="K1 (Table UG-37) only held for 2:1 heads in v0.1"))
            return
        rec.references.append("ASME8-1:TableUG-37")
        Dc = D + 2 * CA
        tr_fn = lambda Pv: Pv * K1_2TO1 * Dc / (2 * Sv - 0.2 * Pv)   # noqa: E731
        tr = tr_fn(P)
        rec.eq("tr = P K1 D / (2 Sv - 0.2 P), K1 = 0.90 (opening inside the 80 % circle)",
               f"{P:.4f} x 0.90 x {Dc:.2f} / (2 x {Sv:.1f} - 0.2 x {P:.4f}) = {tr:.3f} mm")
    elif head.type == "hemispherical":
        L = (D + 2 * CA) / 2
        tr_fn = lambda Pv: Pv * L / (2 * Sv - 0.2 * Pv)      # noqa: E731
        tr = tr_fn(P)
        rec.eq("tr = P L / (2 Sv - 0.2 P)", f"= {tr:.3f} mm")
    else:
        L = head.crown_radius + CA
        tr_fn = lambda Pv: Pv * L / (2 * Sv - 0.2 * Pv)      # noqa: E731
        tr = tr_fn(P)
        rec.eq("tr = P L / (2 Sv - 0.2 P)  (spherical crown, M = 1)", f"= {tr:.3f} mm")
    tr = rec.mid("tr", tr, MM, "required parent thickness, seamless")
    En = 1.0
    trn = rec.mid("trn", F.shell_t_circ(P, Rn, Sn, En), MM, "required neck thickness, seamless (E = 1)")
    rec.eq("trn = P Rn / (Sn - 0.6 P)", f"{P:.4f} x {Rn:.2f} / ({Sn:.1f} - 0.6 x {P:.4f}) = {trn:.3f} mm")
    r_open = max(neck.od / 2, (nz.pad.od / 2) if nz.pad else 0.0)
    E1, seam_note = _seam_E1(ctx, nz, ge, r_open)
    extra = []
    if seam_note:
        rec.warnings.append(seam_note + " (UW-14): E1 = seam efficiency, review required")
        extra.append(seam_note)
    Fc = rec.mid("F", 1.0, "-", "correction factor, longitudinal plane (radial nozzle)")
    E1 = rec.mid("E1", E1, "-", "1.0: opening not in a seam" if not seam_note else seam_note)
    te = nz.pad.thickness if nz.pad else 0.0
    Dp = nz.pad.od if nz.pad else 0.0
    Sp = None
    if nz.pad:
        Sp, how_p = ctx.S(nz.pad.material, ctx.vi.process.design_temperature)
        rec.inp("Sp", Sp, MPA, how_p, source=f"MAT-{nz.pad.material}")
        rec.inp("te", te, MM, "pad thickness")
        rec.inp("Dp", Dp, MM, "pad outside diameter")
        if Dp <= neck.od:
            rec.criterion_met = False
            rec.status_reasons.append("pad OD does not clear the nozzle")
            ctx.add(rec.finalize())
            return
    legs = nz.weld_legs
    h_in = nz.inward_projection
    common = dict(d=d, t=t, tn=tn, Sv=Sv, Sn=Sn, Sp=Sp, te=te, Dp=Dp, F=Fc, E1=E1,
                  leg41=legs.get("nozzle_outer_leg") or 0.0, leg42=legs.get("pad_outer_leg") or 0.0,
                  leg43=legs.get("inner_leg") or 0.0, h=h_in, ti=tn - CA if h_in > 0 else 0.0,
                  inserted=nz.attachment == "set_in")
    ar = F.area_replacement(tr=tr, trn=trn, **common)
    fr1, fr2, fr3, fr4 = ar["fr1"], ar["fr2"], ar["fr3"], ar["fr4"]
    rec.mid("fr2", fr2, "-", "Sn/Sv (<= 1)")
    rec.mid("fr1", fr1, "-", "set-in: Sn/Sv; set-on: 1.0")
    if nz.pad:
        rec.mid("fr4", fr4, "-", "Sp/Sv (<= 1)")
        rec.mid("fr3", fr3, "-", "min(Sn, Sp)/Sv")
    lim_par = rec.mid("limit_parallel", ar["limit_parallel"], MM, "UG-40: max(d, Rn + tn + t)")
    lim_nor = rec.mid("limit_normal", ar["limit_normal"], MM, "UG-40: min(2.5 t, 2.5 tn + te)")
    te_eff, Dp_eff = ar["te_eff"], ar["Dp_eff"]
    if te > lim_nor:
        rec.warnings.append(f"pad thickness {te:g} mm > normal limit {lim_nor:.2f} mm: only the part within the limit counted")
    if Dp > 2 * lim_par:
        rec.warnings.append(f"pad OD {Dp:g} mm > 2 x parallel limit {2 * lim_par:.1f} mm: only {Dp_eff:.1f} mm counted")
    A = rec.res("A", ar["A"], MM2, "required area")
    rec.eq("A = d tr F + 2 tn tr F (1 - fr1)", f"{d:.2f} x {tr:.3f} + 2 x {tn:.2f} x {tr:.3f} x (1 - {fr1:.3f}) = {A:.1f} mm2")
    ex = ar["excess_shell"]
    A1 = rec.res("A1", ar["A1"], MM2, "excess in the shell: larger of the two Fig. UG-37.1 expressions")
    rec.eq("A1 = max[d (E1 t - F tr) - 2 tn (E1 t - F tr)(1 - fr1), 2 (t + tn)(E1 t - F tr) - 2 tn (E1 t - F tr)(1 - fr1)]",
           f"E1 t - F tr = {ex:.3f} mm -> A1 = {A1:.1f} mm2")
    sur = ar["surplus_nozzle"]
    A2 = rec.res("A2", ar["A2"], MM2, "excess in the nozzle wall outward")
    if nz.pad:
        rec.eq("A2 = min[5 (tn - trn) fr2 t, 2 (tn - trn)(2.5 tn + te) fr2]",
               f"min(5 x {sur:.3f} x {fr2:.3f} x {t:.3f}, 2 x {sur:.3f} x (2.5 x {tn:.3f} + {te_eff:.2f}) x {fr2:.3f}) = {A2:.1f} mm2")
    else:
        rec.eq("A2 = min[5 (tn - trn) fr2 t, 5 (tn - trn) fr2 tn]",
               f"min(5 x {sur:.3f} x {fr2:.3f} x {t:.3f}, 5 x {sur:.3f} x {fr2:.3f} x {tn:.3f}) = {A2:.1f} mm2")
    A3 = rec.res("A3", ar["A3"], MM2, "inward projection")
    A41 = rec.res("A41", ar["A41"], MM2, "outer nozzle weld (0 if not defined)")
    A42 = rec.res("A42", ar["A42"], MM2, "pad outer weld")
    A43 = rec.res("A43", ar["A43"], MM2, "inner weld")
    A5 = rec.res("A5", ar["A5"], MM2, "pad: (Dp - d - 2 tn) te fr4")
    if nz.pad:
        rec.eq("A5 = (Dp - d - 2 tn) te fr4",
               f"({Dp_eff:.1f} - {d:.2f} - 2 x {tn:.2f}) x {te_eff:.2f} x {fr4:.3f} = {A5:.1f} mm2")
    tot = rec.res("A_avail", ar["A_avail"], MM2)
    rec.eq("A_avail = A1 + A2 + A3 + A41 + A42 + A43 + A5",
           f"{A1:.1f} + {A2:.1f} + {A3:.1f} + {A41:.1f} + {A42:.1f} + {A43:.1f} + {A5:.1f} = {tot:.1f} mm2 vs A = {A:.1f} mm2")
    rec.res("margin", tot - A, MM2)
    if not nz.pad:
        need = A - (A1 + A2 + A3 + A41 + A43)
        if need > 0:
            rec.warnings.append(f"without a pad the opening is short by {need:.0f} mm2")
    if all(v is None for v in legs.values()):
        extra.append("weld areas taken as zero (no weld sizes): conservative for the area check")
    rec.criterion_met = tot >= A - 1e-9
    # largest pressure for which this opening's area check is met (margin falls as P rises)
    def margin(Pv):
        r = F.area_replacement(tr=tr_fn(Pv), trn=Pv * Rn / (Sn - 0.6 * Pv), **common)
        return r["A_avail"] - r["A"]
    P_hi = 0.385 * min(Sv, Sn) * 0.999
    if margin(P_hi) >= 0:
        P_max, how = P_hi, "area check met up to the UG-27 validity limit (0.385 S)"
    elif margin(1e-6) < 0:
        P_max, how = 0.0, "area check not met at any pressure"
    else:
        lo, hi = 1e-6, P_hi
        for _ in range(100):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            lo, hi = (mid, hi) if margin(mid) >= 0 else (lo, mid)
        P_max, how = lo, "bisection on A_avail(P) = A(P)"
    rec.res("P_max_opening", P_max, MPA, how)
    ctx.mawp_parts[f"opening {nz.tag}"] = P_max - (Pn - ctx.vi.process.design_pressure)
    ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references, mats, [e for e in extra if "conservative" not in e])))


def _flange(ctx, nz, Pn):
    if nz.flange is None:
        return
    fl = nz.flange
    rec = CalcRecord(f"NZ-{nz.tag}-FLG", f"Nozzle {nz.tag}",
                     f"Flange {nz.tag} pressure-temperature rating ({fl.standard} Class {fl.pressure_class})",
                     method="design pressure at the nozzle <= rating at design temperature",
                     references=["ASME8-1:UG-44", "ASME:B16.5"], criterion="P <= rating(T_design)")
    rec.inp("P", Pn, MPA, "design pressure + static head at the nozzle")
    rec.inp("T", ctx.vi.process.design_temperature, "degC")
    if fl.rating_at_design_temperature is None:
        rec.questions.append(f"give the {fl.standard} Class {fl.pressure_class} rating of the "
                             f"{fl.material} flange material group at {ctx.vi.process.design_temperature:g} degC")
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="flange rating not supplied"))
        return
    r = rec.inp("rating", fl.rating_at_design_temperature, MPA, fl.rating_source, source=f"USER ({fl.rating_status})")
    rec.res("margin", r - Pn, MPA)
    rec.criterion_met = r >= Pn - 1e-12
    extra = [] if fl.rating_status in ("VERIFIED_OFFICIAL", "USER_SUPPLIED_VERIFIED") else \
        [f"flange rating {fl.rating_status}"]
    # the rating limits the pressure at the flange; refer it to the top (UG-98)
    ctx.mawp_parts[f"flange {nz.tag}"] = r - (Pn - ctx.vi.process.design_pressure)
    ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references, [], extra)))


def _spacing(ctx: Ctx):
    rec = CalcRecord("NZ-UG42", "Nozzles", "Spacing of openings (overlapping reinforcement limits)",
                     method="pairwise centre distance on the shell surface vs sum of UG-40 parallel limits",
                     references=["ASME8-1:UG-42", "ASME8-1:UG-40"],
                     criterion="no two openings have overlapping limits of reinforcement")
    limits = {r.calc_id.split("-")[1]: r.value("limit_parallel") for r in ctx.records
              if r.calc_id.endswith("-UG37") and any(tv.symbol == "limit_parallel" for tv in r.intermediates)}
    shell = [n for n in ctx.geometry["nozzles"] if n["location"] == "shell" and n["tag"] in limits]
    R = ctx.geometry["vessel"]["inside_diameter"] / 2
    overl = []
    for i, a in enumerate(shell):
        for b in shell[i + 1:]:
            dth = math.radians(abs((a["orientation"] - b["orientation"] + 180) % 360 - 180))
            dist = math.hypot(R * dth, a["z"] - b["z"])
            need = limits[a["tag"]] + limits[b["tag"]]
            rec.mid(f"{a['tag']}-{b['tag']}", round(dist, 1), MM, f"centre distance (limits sum {need:.1f} mm)")
            if dist < need:
                overl.append(f"{a['tag']}/{b['tag']}")
    if overl:
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(out_of_scope="overlapping limits " + ", ".join(overl) + ": UG-42 not implemented"))
        return
    rec.criterion_met = True
    ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references)))

def mawp_record(ctx: Ctx):
    p = ctx.vi.process
    rec = CalcRecord("MAWP", "Vessel", "Maximum allowable working pressure (UG-98)",
                     method="lowest part MAWP referred to the top of the vessel (corroded, hot)",
                     references=["ASME8-1:UG-98"], criterion="MAWP >= design pressure")
    for k, v in sorted(ctx.mawp_parts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]):
        rec.mid(f"MAWP[{k}]", v, MPA)
    missing = [r.component for r in ctx.records
               if r.calc_id.endswith("-FLG") and r.criterion_met is None]
    if not ctx.mawp_parts:
        ctx.add(rec.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="no component MAWP available"))
        return None
    gov = min(ctx.mawp_parts, key=ctx.mawp_parts.get)
    mawp = rec.res("MAWP", ctx.mawp_parts[gov], MPA, f"governed by {gov}")
    rec.res("governing", gov)
    rec.inp("P_design", p.design_pressure, MPA)
    rec.criterion_met = mawp >= p.design_pressure - 1e-12
    extra = []
    if missing:
        extra.append("flange ratings missing for " + ", ".join(sorted(set(missing))) + " (MAWP may be lower)")
    no_pmax = [r.component for r in ctx.records if r.calc_id.endswith("-UG37") and
               not any(tv.symbol == "P_max_opening" for tv in r.results)]
    if no_pmax:
        extra.append("opening MAWP not computed for " + ", ".join(no_pmax))
    extra += ctx.mawp_notes
    ctx.add(rec.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(rec.references, [], extra)))
    return mawp


def test_records(ctx: Ctx, mawp):
    p, vi = ctx.vi.process, ctx.vi
    factor = 1.3 if p.test_type == "hydrostatic" else 1.1
    ref = "ASME8-1:UG-99(b)" if p.test_type == "hydrostatic" else "ASME8-1:UG-100"
    rec = CalcRecord("TEST-P", "Vessel", f"{p.test_type.capitalize()} test pressure",
                     kind=RecordKind.COMPUTATION, method=f"{factor} x basis pressure x LSR", references=[ref])
    ratios = {}
    for key, ma in vi.materials.items():
        if ma.record is None:
            continue
        used = any(key in r.materials for r in ctx.records if r.code_family == "ASME_VIII_1" and not r.calc_id.startswith("MAT-"))
        if not used:
            continue
        Sd, _ = ctx.S(key, p.design_temperature)
        St, _ = ctx.S(key, p.test_temperature)
        if Sd and St:
            ratios[key] = St / Sd
            rec.mid(f"S_test/S_design[{key}]", St / Sd, "-")
    if not ratios:
        ctx.add(rec.finalize())
        return None
    lsr = rec.mid("LSR", min(ratios.values()), "-", "lowest stress ratio of the pressure-part materials")
    basis = mawp if p.test_basis == "MAWP" else p.design_pressure
    if basis is None:
        rec.warnings.append("MAWP not available; test pressure not computed")
        ctx.add(rec.finalize())
        return None
    rec.inp("basis", p.test_basis)
    rec.inp("P_basis", basis, MPA)
    Pt = rec.res("P_test_top", factor * basis * lsr, MPA, "minimum test pressure at the top of the vessel")
    rec.eq(f"P_test = {factor} x P_basis x LSR", f"{factor} x {basis:.4f} x {lsr:.4f} = {Pt:.4f} MPa")
    if p.test_basis == "design_pressure":
        rec.warnings.append("design-pressure basis is permitted by the UG-99(b) footnote only when the MAWP "
                            "is not calculated; confirm with the Inspector")
    H = ctx.geometry["vessel"]["inside_height"]
    if p.test_type == "hydrostatic":
        dh = hydrostatic(H if p.test_position == "vertical" else ctx.vi.geometry.inside_diameter, p.test_fluid_density)
        rec.mid("test_head", dh, MPA, f"water head over {('inside height' if p.test_position == 'vertical' else 'diameter')}")
        rec.res("P_test_bottom", Pt + dh, MPA, f"at the lowest point, test in {p.test_position} position")
    ctx.add(rec.finalize())

    # informational membrane stress during the test (not a VIII-1 acceptance rule here)
    s = CalcRecord("TEST-STRESS", "Vessel", "Shell membrane stress during the test (informational)",
                   method="sigma = P (R + 0.6 t)/(E t) at the lowest course vs 0.9 x min. yield (room temperature)",
                   references=["ASME2D:TableY1", ref], mandatory=False,
                   criterion="sigma_test <= 0.9 Sy (screening limit; confirm the governing limit with the Inspector)")
    c0 = vi.geometry.shell_courses[0]
    ma = vi.materials[c0.material]
    t = ctx.available.get(c0.id)
    Pb = Pt + (hydrostatic(H, p.test_fluid_density) if p.test_type == "hydrostatic" and p.test_position == "vertical" else 0.0)
    E = ctx.joint_E.get("shell_longitudinal")
    Sy = ma.record.min_yield if ma.record else None
    if t is None or E is None or not Sy:
        ctx.add(s.finalize(not_evaluated_reason="thickness, E or yield not available"))
        return Pt
    R = vi.geometry.inside_diameter / 2 + p.corrosion_allowance
    sig = s.res("sigma_test", Pb * (R + 0.6 * t) / (E * t), MPA)
    s.inp("Sy", Sy, MPA, "minimum yield (material record; room temperature)", source=f"MAT-{c0.material}")
    s.res("ratio", sig / (0.9 * Sy), "-")
    s.criterion_met = sig <= 0.9 * Sy
    ctx.add(s.finalize(unverified=["screening limit is not a verified VIII-1 acceptance criterion"]
                       + ctx.unverified(s.references, [c0.material])))
    return Pt


def weight_records(ctx: Ctx):
    geo, p = ctx.geometry, ctx.vi.process
    rec = CalcRecord("WT", "Vessel", "Weights, volume and centre of gravity", kind=RecordKind.COMPUTATION,
                     method="exact profiles + quadrature per component (geometry/profiles.py); rho from material records",
                     references=["GEN:mechanics"])
    W_empty, cg = centre_of_gravity(geo)
    for grp in sorted({c["bom_group"] for c in geo["components"]}):
        rec.mid(f"mass[{grp}]", sum(c["mass_kg"] or 0 for c in geo["components"] if c["bom_group"] == grp), KG)
    missing = [c["tag"] for c in geo["components"] if c["mass_kg"] is None]
    if missing:
        rec.warnings.append("no density for " + ", ".join(missing) + ": excluded from weights")
    V = geo["vessel"]["internal_volume_mm3"]
    rec.res("W_empty", W_empty, KG, "net theoretical, fabricated (no internals, no insulation, no bolting/gaskets)")
    rec.res("CG_empty_z", cg[2], MM, "above grade")
    rec.res("V_internal", V / 1e9, "m3")
    contents = 0.0
    if p.liquid_level is not None and p.liquid_density is not None:
        g = ctx.vi.geometry
        a = g.inside_diameter / 2
        h = p.liquid_level
        if h > g.tangent_to_tangent:
            rec.warnings.append("liquid level above the top tangent line: liquid in the top head not included")
            h = g.tangent_to_tangent
        hb = g.heads["bottom"]
        prof = HeadProfile(hb.type, a, hb.aspect_ratio or 2.0, hb.crown_radius or 0.0, hb.knuckle_radius or 0.0)
        V_liq = rec.mid("V_liquid", (prof.solid_volume(0.0)[0] + math.pi * a * a * h) / 1e9, "m3",
                        "bottom head below BTL + cylinder up to the liquid level")
        contents = V_liq * p.liquid_density
    elif p.fluid_phase == "gas":
        rec.warnings.append("gas contents mass not included (no gas density in the design basis)")
    W_op = rec.res("W_operating", W_empty + contents, KG)
    W_test = rec.res("W_test", W_empty + V * (p.test_fluid_density or 0) * 1e-9, KG,
                     f"vessel full of test fluid ({p.test_fluid_density or 0:g} kg/m3)")
    ctx.add(rec.finalize())
    if p.required_volume:
        v = CalcRecord("VOL-REQ", "Vessel", "Internal volume vs required volume", code_family="PROJECT",
                       method="internal volume from exact head profiles", references=["PROJECT:requirement"],
                       criterion="V_internal >= V_required")
        v.inp("V_required", p.required_volume / 1e9, "m3")
        v.res("V_internal", V / 1e9, "m3")
        v.criterion_met = V >= p.required_volume
        ctx.add(v.finalize(unverified=ctx.unverified(v.references)))
    return {"empty": W_empty, "operating": W_op, "test": W_test, "cg_empty": cg}
